document.abstract: In this paper, we propose a conditional entropy coded tree-structured vector quantizer for video coding, which efficiently exploits interblock correlation on motion compensated error images. Simulation results show that performance improvement by the proposed high-order encoding method is remarkable even with very low additional complexity.
